title: RunEvidence Record
description: Machine-readable evidence record for one completed ai-loop run (#874). Contract: docs/workflows/ai-loop/run-evidence-contract.md. evidence_status (complete/partial) is NOT stored here: it is derived by run_evidence_verify.py (trust boundary, contract section 2-1).

run_id.description: Identifier of the ai-loop run this evidence describes.

task_id.description: Bound to the task_dir directory name by the verifier.

started_at.description: Injected via --started-at. Never derived from now().

completed_at.description: Injected via --now. Never derived from now().

repository.description: Owner-stripped repository name (e.g. plangate, NOT s977043/plangate). Contract section 7-3.

source_sha.description: From approvals/c3.json. Re-verified by the verifier.

final_head_sha.description: unavailable when terminal_state=BLOCKED (delivery/record.jsonl does not exist). Never padded with an empty string or a dummy sha.

plan_hash.description: From approvals/c3.json. Re-verified by the verifier against the task_dir.

harness_version.description: Object of 3 values (contract section 4-1). AC-12 compares all 3 byte-for-byte between run start and run end.

routing_decisions.description: Phase 1: always unavailable (#868 is OPEN, no producer exists). Never padded with an empty array.

repair_rounds.description: delivery._completed_rounds() return value. unavailable when the PR number cannot be resolved: never 0 (contract section 3-2).

terminal_state.description: Normalized per contract section 4. Non-terminal runs do not emit a RunEvidence record at all.

quality_metrics.description: Only metrics that close over the events of this single run. Corpus-wide aggregates (decision_counts / round_distribution / hotl_health / first_pass_rate) are forbidden: they would break determinism (contract section 3-3).

evidence_refs.description: Repo-relative references only. Enumerated from injected values or record.jsonl: never by scanning the disk (contract section 3-3).

schema_version.description: Required, not optional: a record with an unknown version makes the versioning policy mechanically void (contract section 9).

observation.description: Observed facts only. Kept separate from cause_hypothesis (AC-5).

cause_hypothesis.description: Inference. The producer never generates this automatically: null when not injected (AC-5).

escalation.description: Anomalies that must not be swallowed (unknown record kind, privacy-violating input, unclassifiable record). Must stay registered here: under additionalProperties=false an unregistered escalation would reject exactly the records that need verification most.

^_.description: Annotation-only keys (same convention as schemas/c3-prime.schema.json). String values only: the verifier rejects non-string annotation values.

unavailable.description: Explicitly not obtainable. Distinct from 0 and from an empty array.

repoRelativePath.description: Absolute paths are forbidden (metrics-privacy.md sections 4 and 5).
